text: Name an AI model released by Google or DeepMind
note: Any model from Google Research, Google Brain, DeepMind or Google DeepMind: LLMs, architectures, agents, science and media. Major versions count separately

answers.q: A ~400M Gemma that predicts the next dolphin whistle, trained on decades of wild spotted-dolphin recordings.
Shipped in August 2026 and was routed to 3.8 Flash by October. Flash years are short.
Experimental text diffusion LM (2025): refines whole blocks at once instead of writing left to right.
Mobile-first Gemma with per-layer embeddings and MatFormer nesting.
Gemma on the Griffin architecture: linear recurrences plus local attention.
Gemma grounded in Data Commons statistics to cut down on hallucinated numbers.
Gemma converted into an encoder-decoder. T5 lives on.
A 1B Gemma trained from scratch with differential privacy.
Hundreds of sparse autoencoders trained on Gemma's activations, released for interpretability work.
A 27B Gemma that reads cells as sentences. Its cancer-therapy hypothesis was confirmed in the lab.
Text-to-3D with no 3D data: Imagen grades a NeRF through score distillation.
ICML 2016 best paper: images generated one pixel at a time.
A recurrent VAE with attention that draws an image a patch at a time (2015).
Renders a scene from new viewpoints after seeing a few images of it. Science, 2018.
Evolved, not designed: found by regularized (aging) evolution.
Self-training with a bigger, noised student: 88.4% ImageNet top-1 in 2019.
Object detection as language modeling: boxes spelled out as discrete tokens.
Normalizer-Free: no BatchNorm, adaptive gradient clipping instead.
Hinton's capsules, routed by agreement instead of max pooling. Google Brain Toronto, 2017.
A differentiable module that learns to crop, rotate and warp its own input.
Google used the name twice: a photo geolocator (2016) and a latent-planning RL agent (2018).
Direct speech-to-speech translation, no text in between.
2B params, 300+ languages: the speech model behind YouTube captions and Chirp.
Neural audio codec with residual vector quantization; the tokenizer under AudioLM and MusicLM.
Relative attention for minute-long piano performances (2018).
A WaveNet autoencoder that blends instruments, released with a ~300k-note dataset.
Differentiable oscillators and filters inside a neural net.
Powered the 2019 Bach Doodle, Google's first AI-powered Doodle.
Play a piano with 8 buttons and let the model pick the notes.
Trained on Quick, Draw! doodles to sketch cats, pigs and yoga poses stroke by stroke.
Recurrent Replay Distributed DQN, which conveniently abbreviates to a droid.
'For The Win': human-level Quake III Capture the Flag from pixels. Science, 2019.
Reached an all-time top-3 ranking on the Gravon Stratego platform, bluffing included.
Liverpool FC experts preferred its corner-kick suggestions to the real tactics 90% of the time.
Seven robot arms, 580,000 real grasp attempts, one Q-function (2018).

aka: Do As I Can, Not As I Say
answers.q: 'Do As I Can, Not As I Say': the LLM proposes, learned affordances dispose.
130k episodes from 13 robots over 17 months, tokenized into one transformer policy.
Open X-Embodiment: one policy trained on data pooled from 22 robot types.
Robot fleet orchestration that shipped with a 'Robot Constitution' inspired by Asimov.
A self-improving robot agent built on Gato that generates its own training data.
RL chip floorplanning used for TPU layouts, and a long-running reproducibility fight.
A transformer that decodes surface-code errors, trained with Google Quantum AI on Sycamore data.
Designs new protein binders from scratch, including one for VEGF-A.
An embedding for every 10-meter square of Earth's land and coastal waters.
A neural-network wavefunction for solving the many-electron Schrödinger equation.
Met Office forecasters ranked its rain nowcasts first in 89% of cases. Nature, 2021.
Restores and dates ancient Greek inscriptions; historians went from 25% to 72% accuracy with it.
A diagnostic dialogue agent that out-scored primary-care doctors in text-based consults.
Architecture search found squared ReLUs and depthwise convs inside attention.
Swap self-attention for a Fourier transform and keep 92–97% of BERT's GLUE accuracy.
T5 on raw UTF-8 bytes. No tokenizer at all.
A transformer that memorizes the corpus and answers queries with document IDs.
Recommends by generating the next item's Semantic ID, token by token.
Outputs positions in its own input instead of words: neural convex hulls and TSP tours.
A Project Zero and DeepMind agent that found an exploitable SQLite bug before it shipped (2024).
LLMs that draft group consensus statements. Participants preferred them to human mediators'.
Search's 2021 model, pitched as '1,000 times more powerful than BERT'.
Google Search's first deep-learning ranking signal, revealed in 2015.
Dec 2024, billed as 'our new AI model for the agentic era'.
Google's first '.1' release (Feb 2026): 77.1% on ARC-AGI-2, up from Gemini 3 Pro's 31.1%.
May 2026, Flash first: it beat Gemini 3.1 Pro on agentic coding benchmarks.
May 2026: one model that generates and edits video from any mix of text, images, audio and video.
Gemini 2.0 turned vision-language-action model (March 2025). Its demos included folding origami.
SigLIP plus Gemma, built to be fine-tuned.
A 308M multilingual embedding model small enough to run on a phone.
Dec 2024: up to 4K output and a better grip on physics.
2024: a playable platformer world model learned from unlabeled internet videos.
DeepMind's music model, debuted with YouTube's Dream Track in 2023.
Text to music (2023), shipped with the MusicCaps dataset of 5.5k expert-captioned clips.
Language modeling on audio tokens: continues speech or piano from a few seconds of prompt.
20B params treating images as a translation target, one token at a time.
Masked image tokens decoded in parallel: faster than diffusion or autoregression.
Variable-length video from a story told as a sequence of prompts, 2022.
A Space-Time U-Net that generates the whole clip at once, not keyframes then fill-in.
An LLM that speaks video tokens: text, image or audio in, video out (2023).
Fine-tune on 3–5 photos tied to a rare-token identifier, and your dog can go anywhere.
Class-conditional GANs at scale, 2018. The truncation trick traded variety for fidelity.
An RNN with differentiable read and write heads on an external memory, 2014.
Learned to plan routes on the London Underground from its own memory. Nature, 2016.
Many CPU actors, no replay buffer, asynchronous updates (2016).
DQN's tricks for continuous actions: a deterministic actor plus a Q critic (2015).
Six DQN improvements in one agent. The ablations were the point.
First agent to beat the human baseline on all 57 Atari games (2020).
DreamerV3 collected Minecraft diamonds from scratch, learning inside its own world model.
Robot actions emitted as text tokens by a VLM: the vision-language-action recipe.
562B-parameter embodied model: PaLM plus a ViT, planning for robots.
Cross-attend from a small latent array to any input: pixels, audio, point clouds.
DeepMind's 280B model, promptly beaten by its smaller sibling Chinchilla.
7.5B params plus a 2-trillion-token retrieval database matched GPT-3.
DeepMind's rule-following dialogue agent, built on Chinchilla.
A 2.6B-parameter chatbot (2020), judged on a new metric: sensibleness and specificity.
1.2T-parameter MoE that beat GPT-3 on a third of its training energy.
Instruction tuning, 2021: phrase many tasks as instructions, get zero-shot gains on new ones.
PaLM fine-tuned on math papers and web pages: 50.3% on MATH in 2022.
First AI past the passing mark on USMLE-style exam questions (2022).
Summarization pretraining by masking out whole 'gap sentences'.
Permutation language modeling from CMU and Google Brain. Beat BERT on 20 tasks in 2019.
Segment-level recurrence for long context. CMU and Google Brain, 2019.
Random, window and global attention, plus a proof that it's still Turing complete.
LSH attention and reversible layers, so very long sequences fit in memory.
Random features approximate softmax attention in linear time.
Replaced phrase-based Google Translate in 2016, then pulled off zero-shot translation.
2018: an AI that phoned a hair salon to book an appointment, 'mm-hmm' included.
Factorized convolutions, plus the debut of label smoothing.
Extreme Inception: depthwise separable convs all the way down. By the author of Keras.
Inverted residuals and linear bottlenecks.
Found by reinforcement-learning architecture search on 500 GPUs.
BiFPN plus EfficientNet-style compound scaling.
No convolutions, no attention: just MLPs across patches and channels.
Triplet loss and 128-d face embeddings: 99.63% on LFW in 2015.
No negatives and it still doesn't collapse. Half of 2020 tried to work out why.
Google's 2021 CLIP rival: 1.8 billion noisy alt-text pairs, barely filtered.

aka: Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training
answers.q: CLIP with a sigmoid instead of a softmax, so no batch-wide normalization.
Convolution plus self-attention for speech recognition, 2020.
A decoder-only foundation model for forecasting, pretrained on ~100B real-world time points.
Variant calling as image classification: read pileups rendered as pictures for a CNN.
Found faster sorting routines, now merged into LLVM's libc++.
A 47-multiplication algorithm for 4×4 matrices mod 2, beating Strassen's 49.
LLM-guided program search that beat the best-known cap sets in dimension 8. Nature, 2023.
Classified 89% of all 71 million possible human missense variants.
Reads up to a million DNA letters and predicts thousands of regulatory tracks.
2.2 million new crystals, about 380,000 predicted stable.
Diffusion-based ensemble weather that beat ECMWF's ENS on 97% of targets.
A Gemini multi-agent system that generates, debates and ranks research hypotheses.
Memorization plus generalization: a linear model and an MLP trained jointly for Google Play.
A million-token context window in Feb 2024. Needle, meet haystack.
The 'thinking' generation (March 2025). A Deep Think version hit gold-medal standard at IMO 2025.
Nov 2025: topped LMArena at launch and shipped into Search on day one.
Argon (Sept 30, 2026), then Carbon four weeks later. The flagships are now named off the periodic table.
April 2026, and the first Gemma released under Apache 2.0.
540B params trained on Pathways. Explained jokes in 2022, to great fanfare.
The one a Google engineer declared sentient in 2022. Google disagreed.
Its launch ad flubbed a JWST fact and Alphabet lost ~$100B in market value in a day.
70B params on 1.4T tokens beat 280B Gopher. ~20 tokens per parameter became gospel.
Perceiver resampler plus gated cross-attention into a frozen Chinchilla. Few-shot VQA, 2022.
Spanish for 'cat'. One 1.2B transformer for 604 tasks: Atari, captions, chat and block stacking.
Route each token to just one expert. 1.6 trillion parameters in 2021.
Shared layers and factorized embeddings: 18x fewer parameters than BERT-large.
A discriminator spots replaced tokens instead of predicting masked ones. Stanford and Google Brain.
Sutskever, Vinyals and Le, 2014: one LSTM reads, another writes. Reversing the input helped.
Taught itself chess, shogi and Go from the rules alone, then crushed Stockfish.
Learned Go by self-play alone and beat the version that beat Lee Sedol 100–0.
AlphaZero without being told the rules: it learns its own model of the game.
Grandmaster level in StarCraft II with all three races, 2019.
One network, raw pixels, 49 Atari games. Nature, 2015.
Reached median Codeforces level (2022) by sampling and filtering huge piles of programs.
Gemini-driven evolution that found a 48-multiplication algorithm for 4×4 complex matrices.
A language model plus a symbolic engine: 25 of 30 olympiad geometry problems.
With AlphaGeometry 2, silver-medal standard at IMO 2024. Its proofs are checked in Lean.
CASP14, 2020: median GDT 92.4. A Nobel Prize in Chemistry followed in 2024.
Diffusion over all atoms: proteins with DNA, RNA, ligands and ions. Built with Isomorphic Labs.
10-day global forecasts in under a minute on one TPU, beating ECMWF's HRES on 90% of targets.
Dilated causal convolutions over raw audio, one sample at a time. Became the Google Assistant's voice.
Text to spectrogram with attention. Tacotron 2 put a WaveNet vocoder on the end.
Google's 2022 photorealist on a frozen T5-XXL text encoder, kept behind closed doors at launch.
May 2025: video with synced sound and dialogue. Cue a flood of fake street interviews.
Aug 2025: real-time interactive 720p worlds that stay consistent for minutes.
An anonymous LMArena codename so catchy that Google kept it.
Gemini 3 Pro Image, Nov 2025: legible text, infographics and up to 4K output.
An image is worth 16×16 words. Google Brain Zurich, 2020.
The capital L salutes LeNet. Won ILSVRC 2014 and cites the 'we need to go deeper' meme.
Depthwise separable convolutions with a width-multiplier knob.
Compound scaling: grow depth, width and resolution together with one φ.
Hinton's Toronto Brain team, 2020: two augmentations, one contrastive loss, a very large batch.
Gradient ascent on an Inception net: dogs and eyes sprouting from everything, 2015.
Eight Google authors, one 2017 paper, and the T in GPT. Not a bad trade for OpenAI.
Mikolov et al., Google, 2013: king − man + woman ≈ queen.
The name nods to twins (Google Brain and DeepMind, merged in 2023) and to NASA's Project Gemini.
Masked words, both directions, Oct 2018. Kicked off a Sesame Street naming craze.
Every NLP task as text-to-text. Also gave the world the C4 dataset.
Latin for 'precious stone'. Gemini's open-weights little sibling, Feb 2024.
Beat Lee Sedol 4–1 in 2016. Move 37 still gets talked about.
DeepMind's CASP13 winner, 2018. The sequel is the one with the Nobel.
